newsitem.title: FRANCE: CCF says rating upgrade was in August.
newsitem.headline: CCF says rating upgrade was in August.

text.p: Credit Commercial de France (CCF) said on Thursday its chairman was referring to a credit rating upgrade made last month when he announced that the French bank's rating was about to be increased.
A spokeswoman for the bank said Charles de Croisset was talking about an upgrade made in August by BankWatch, which boosted CCF's issuer rating to B from B/C.
De Croisset had told a Paris investment seminar that CCF was "a very solid bank whose rating is in the process of being raised."
CCF shares rose during the day on the back of his comments but fell back to close unchanged at 232 francs.
